g.text: E: lower-volume NP and PA, mostly tirzepatide, new in 2024
D: lower-volume primary care, little or no tirzepatide, new in 2024
C: mid-volume primary care, little or no tirzepatide
B: mid-volume NP and PA, some tirzepatide
A: high-volume primary care, some tirzepatide

Source: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers by Provider and Drug 2023-2024 (rows with at least 11 claims), NPPES. Part D reflects diabetes and other covered uses, not obesity-brand adoption; segments describe
prescribers with 11 or more claims for a drug.
